mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or if FEDFUNDS show no sustained decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in labor participation rates (PAYEMS) above 140,000 triggers positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as it signals a robust labor market and economic growth.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive despite PAYEMS exceeding 140,000, or the increase is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in total demand (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) above their 2023 averages signals robust economic activity, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST are above thresholds, or if one proxy rises while the other does not.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained rise in the federal funds rate triggers positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as markets anticipate eventual rate cuts and maintain optimism.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive during late-cycle periods despite FEDFUNDS rising, or if the regime is not actually late-cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the supply index (INDPRO) below 115 signals weakening production capacity, prompting market anticipation of rate cuts and positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive despite INDPRO falling below 115, or the decline is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) and surge in labor participation (PAYEMS > 140,000) signals a strengthening labor market, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when both UNRATE and PAYEMS meet specified thresholds, or if one proxy is high while the other is low.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trajectory in total demand (GDPC1) over recent quarters signals robust economic growth, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns as markets anticipate continued expansion.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive despite sustained GDPC1 growth, or if the trend reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Declining unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) and rising housing demand (HOUST > 1000) simultaneously signal a strengthening labor market and housing recovery, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive when both UNRATE and HOUST meet thresholds, or if one proxy is high while the other is low.
